verdict.rationale: Appwrite's CLI docs confirm it can create/manage projects, resources, and Functions programmatically, and the CLI is scriptable (npm module or standalone binary) with a headless MCP server for LLM interaction, supporting an agent-driven, headless setup. However, there is no explicit end-to-end example or evidence of scripting full schema+auth+policy provisioning together in one CLI/agent flow. missing for 10: a documented end-to-end script/example showing schema, auth, and policy setup together via CLI in one automated flow; independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
